title: 第2121章 尸王血炼功再现第2120章 拦路打劫
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，谁能比我极阴更阴！第二卷：玄界第2121章尸王血炼功！再现！（..la）宋文和邬良，一前一后，往东面飞去。
盯着邬良那道佝偻的背影，宋文眼底时而闪过一抹难以觉察的杀机，但却始终没有动手。
也不知是否因为此地有传送阵的缘故，还是其他什么原因，附近往来的邪灵修士和虚族不少，不时便能撞见。
影虚更是不停的在识海中提醒，附近接连有虚族出没。
找不到太好的动手机会，宋文也只能是既来之则安之。
越往东行，源炁就越发稀薄，往来的邪灵修士也越来越多，但大部分人的修为也越来越低。
待出了源炁死域，顿时天光大亮，烈日普照世间万物。
入眼便是一望无际的荒漠。
——凡临近源炁死域之地，必然灵气枯竭、生机尽灭。不论是灵脉宝地，还是青山绿水，都将沦落为不毛之地。
又前行了几万里，大地逐渐恢复了些许生机，有零星的杂草和昆虫出现。
蓦然，一处茂密绿洲撞入眼帘。
绿洲宽不过百余里，其间的修士不少，足有数万人。
这些人的修为高低不一，从元婴到灵虚道仙都能见到；至于是否还有更高修为之人，宋文暂时发现。
他们并非全都是邪灵修士，其中大部分低阶修士身上，均没有源炁的气息。
绿洲的地底深处，有着一条大型地脉，尚未受到源炁污染，正不断散发着灵气，才得以保全了这座绿洲，也令这些修士有个栖身之所。
值得一提的是，邪灵修士虽已将源炁炼化入体，但要想提升修为境界，还是需要炼化灵气或仙灵之气。
炼化源炁，只是让他们多了一种手段，也无需再畏惧源炁的侵体。
邬良带着宋文，直接落在了一处宅院前。
宅院大门高耸，门楣上张牙舞爪的篆刻着‘邬府’二字。
门前，还站着两名炼虚期守卫。

见到邬良出现，两名守卫当即躬身行礼。
“拜见邬良老祖。”
邬良却并不理会，而是对宋文道。
“勾钧道友，此处乃是老夫的府邸。此刻距离子时，尚有几个时辰，不如便在我这府邸，稍作休憩？”
“客随主便，有劳道友了。”宋文道。
“勾钧道友无需如此客套。”邬良抬手朝突然敞开的大门一引，“请！”
接着，两人飞身进入宅院，穿过蜿蜒的走廊后，来到一栋阁楼前。
两人刚踏入阁楼大堂，便有数名美妇迎了出来，讨好而又谄媚的涌向邬良。
“老祖，你总算回来了。”
“多日不见，可想死我等姐妹了。”
一众美妇，围着邬良叽叽喳喳的说着。
她们那丰腴的身躯，不断摩擦挤压着邬良那佝偻干瘪肉身。
“闭嘴！”邬良冷喝一声，“没看到有贵客吗？”
那些美妇，顿时鸦雀无声，眸子齐刷刷的投向宋文。
“这位乃是勾钧道友，老夫刚刚结识的挚友，你们都去陪他吧，不用管老夫。”邬良又道。
看着那些女子媚眼如丝的就朝自己走来，宋文连忙出声。
“不用了。邬良道友，你的好意，在下心领。不过，在下并不好此道。”
几名女子顿时停下了脚步，等待邬良的吩咐。
邬良道，“老夫倒是忘了，道友刚从紫薇仙域而来，那里人族繁多，见惯了各色美人，自然看不上她们这些薄柳之姿。不过，在这人烟稀少之地，她们已经是罕见的美人。”
“道友言重了。在下只是不喜美色而已，并无看轻她们的意思。”宋文道。

“既然如此，老夫也不强人所难。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Among mortals cultivating immortality, who can be more yin than me! Volume 2: Xuanjie Chapter 2121 Corpse King Blood Training! Reappearance! (..la) Song Wen and Wu Liang, one behind the other, flew eastward.
Staring at Wu Liang's hunched back, Song Wen's eyes occasionally flashed with an imperceptible murderous intent, but he never took action.
I don't know whether it's because there is a teleportation array here, or for some other reason. There are many evil spirit monks and virtual people coming and going nearby, and you can bump into them from time to time.
Yingxu kept reminding him in the sea of ​​consciousness that there were Xu clans appearing in the vicinity one after another.
Unable to find a good opportunity to take action, Song Wen could only take it as it came.
The further east you go, the thinner the source energy becomes, and more and more evil spirit monks come and go, but the cultivation level of most people is also getting lower and lower.
After leaving the Source Qi Death Realm, the sky suddenly became bright and the scorching sun shone on everything in the world.
As far as the eye can see, there is an endless desert.
——Any place that is close to the Source Qi Death Zone will inevitably have its spiritual energy exhausted and its vitality extinguished. Whether it is the spiritual treasure land or the green mountains and green waters, they will all be reduced to barren land.
After traveling for tens of thousands of miles, the land gradually regained some vitality, with sporadic weeds and insects appearing.
Suddenly, a lush oasis came into view.
The oasis is no more than a hundred miles wide, and there are many monks in it, tens of thousands of them.
The cultivation levels of these people vary from Yuanying to Lingxu Taoist Immortal. As for whether there are people with higher cultivation levels, Song Wen has temporarily discovered.
Not all of them are evil spirit monks. Most of the low-level monks do not have the aura of Yuanqi in them.
Deep underground in the oasis, there is a large earth vein, which has not been polluted by the source of energy and is constantly exuding spiritual energy, which is why the oasis is preserved and these monks have a place to live.
It is worth mentioning that although the evil spirit monks have refined the source energy into their bodies, they still need to refine spiritual energy or fairy spirit energy if they want to improve their cultivation level.
Refining Yuan Qi only gives them one more method, and they no longer need to fear the invasion of Yuan Qi.
Wu Liang took Song Wen and landed directly in front of a house.
The gate of the house is high, and the word "Wu Mansion" is engraved on the lintel with claws and teeth.
In front of the door, there are still two guards in the Void Refining Stage.
Seeing Wu Liang appear, the two guards immediately bowed and saluted.
"Meet Ancestor Wu Liang."
Wu Liang ignored it and addressed Song Wendao.
"Fellow Taoist Gou Jun, this is my residence. There are still a few hours until midnight. Why don't you take a rest at my residence?"
"As guests do, please do as you wish, fellow Taoist." Song Wen said.
"Fellow Taoist Gou Jun, there is no need to be so polite." Wu Liang raised his hand and pointed towards the suddenly opened door, "Please!"
Then, the two flew into the house, passed through the winding corridor, and came to an attic.
As soon as the two of them stepped into the attic lobby, several beautiful women came out to greet Wu Liang, fawning and flattering them.
"Ancestor, you are finally back."
"I haven't seen you for a long time. I miss my sisters so much."
A group of beautiful women were chattering around Wu Liang.
Their plump bodies were constantly rubbing and squeezing Wu Liang's rickety and shriveled body.
"Shut up!" Wu Liang shouted coldly, "Don't you see any distinguished guests?"
Those beautiful women were immediately silent, and all their eyes turned to Song Wen.
"This is fellow Daoist Gou Jun, a close friend I just met. You all go and accompany him, and don't worry about me." Wu Liang said again.
Seeing those women walking towards him with charming eyes, Song Wen quickly spoke out.
"No need. Fellow Taoist Wu Liang, I appreciate your kindness. However, I am not good at this."
Several women immediately stopped and waited for Wu Liang's instructions.
Wu Liang said, "I have forgotten that my Taoist friends have just come from the Ziwei Fairyland. There are many people there, and they are used to seeing all kinds of beauties. Naturally, they look down on their thin willow figures. However, in this sparsely populated place, they have alreadyShe is a rare beauty. "
"Fellow Taoist, your words are serious. I just don't like beauty, and I don't mean to look down on them. " Song Wendao.
"In this case, I won't force anyone to do anything. "
